text: Quiñenco controls Banco de Chile through LQ Inversiones Financieras S.A. (LQIF), owned in equal parts by Quiñenco and Citigroup; LQIF held 51.2% of the voting and economic rights of Banco de Chile at 31 December 2025.
short: Quiñenco controls Banco de Chile through LQIF, which holds 51.2% of its voting and economic rights.

source.name: Quiñenco S.A.: Banco de Chile (quinenco.cl company page)
source.quote: Quiñenco y Citigroup participan en partes iguales en LQIF, que posee el 51,2% de los derechos de voto y de los derechos económicos del Banco de Chile al 31 de diciembre de 2025
source.note: English: Quiñenco (the Luksic-group holding) controls Banco de Chile through LQIF, held 50/50 with Citigroup. Page header: 'Participación LQIF: 51,2%' at 31 December 2025.
